fonts: Montserrat 800 (bundled; Caveat is unavailable offline — headline tracking is tightened and every headline carries an ink underline)

palette.rule: at most two spot colours per scene; wash only behind a word or an object

hardRules: Do not fill the page: the driver draws paper before your scene. Draw content only.
Everything draws on: every stroke passes rev from K.seq(t, at, at+len). Nothing pops in.
Text: headline through K.headline (screen space, x=100, y=128, size 66, ink underline). Labels through K.keyword (size 34). Nothing inside 80 px of any edge.
Labels are keywords from the script and land on their own word (B.word(si,'word') or B.sentences[si].words[i].t).
Figures: K.figure with s between 0.85 and 1.25, feet on the floor line you draw. Every pose must read in silhouette.
One visible change every 2-4 s; nothing static beyond 3 s; eased and overlapping.
Finish the last draw-on at least 0.25 s before t1. Never leave a stroke half-drawn at a cut.
Deterministic: no Math.random, no Date, no per-frame object creation for geometry. Precompute point lists at module scope.
Only K helpers and local closures: do not edit ink-kit.js, beats.js, audio.js, driver.js, main.js, index.html.
One file per writer: window.SCENES.push({...}) only.
sceneObject: { id, t0, t1, si, draw(ctx, t) }  (si = sentence index or array; t0/t1 from this table)

headline: MARRIAGE ISN'T
A MUST
scenes.change: A wedding ring doodle beside the pulpit gets struck through on 'must'.

headline: THE CASE FOR
SINGLENESS
scenes.change: Three signposts ink on one at a time; on 'pressuring' a shoving crowd's arrows retract.

headline: A QUALIFIER
scenes.change: A red pencil circles the word and slashes through it.

headline: AUTOMATICALLY? NO.
PROBABLY? YES.
scenes.change: The single pastor's question mark becomes a tick on 'No', then a skewed meter needle swings right on 'Yes'.

headline: THE QUESTION ISN'T THAT
scenes.change: Two good things (prayer, fruit) get checked; then a broad slash crosses the whole idea on 'isn't'.

headline: WHAT THE APOSTLES
EXPECTED
scenes.change: A scroll unrolls; a blank silhouette inks into a doorway beside it on 'fit'.

headline: A ONE-WOMAN MAN
scenes.change: A marriage certificate draws on and gets a red X on 'not a certificate'; a ring stays inked.

headline: MANAGE HIS
HOUSEHOLD
scenes.change: A house cutaway inks on; a table, two chairs and a child appear; the pastor lifts a pot.

headline: HOW WILL HE CARE
FOR THE CHURCH?
scenes.change: The house grows a steeple and a pew row: house morphs into church, same people inside.

headline: PROVING GROUND
scenes.change: A platform inks on under the figure; two test marks land on it.

headline: NOT A MAGIC CHECKBOX
scenes.change: A checkbox grid draws on; the tick scribbles itself out; then a strip of daily objects (plate, cup, laundry) inks in.

headline: THE OUTLIER
scenes.change: A bell curve draws itself; one dot lands far outside the hump.

headline: THE BURDEN OF PROOF
scenes.change: A weight is lowered onto the outlier dot; the dot sits lower.

headline: PAUL: A RARE GIFT
scenes.change: Paul's figure inks on with a small flame cupped in both hands; the flame grows on 'gift'.

headline: ONE IN A THOUSAND
scenes.change: A grid of 1000 small marks inks on sweep; one mark turns red.

headline: NOT GIFTED—TICKING
scenes.change: The figure gets a fuse-and-clock doodle; the fuse burns down on the beat; a red scribble cross.

headline: LOOK FOR A HUSBAND
AND A FATHER
scenes.change: Character gets a tick, then 'husband' and 'father' are circled one after the other.
